Package com.hkust.marketplace.repositories

Class ListingRepository

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.repositories.ListingRepository
public class ListingRepository extends Object
MySQL persistence for listings, photos, and review/moderation state.

Maps joined seller/deal terms, saves and loads listing photos, supports admin review and content edits, applies optimistic locking through row_version, and performs soft removal of listings.

  • Method Details

    • reserveForDeal

      public boolean reserveForDeal(Connection connection, String listingId, String sellerUsername) throws SQLException
      Reserve a LIVE listing as part of the same transaction that accepts its deal.

      Caller-owned connection: this method never commits. The update matches only a listing owned by sellerUsername that is still LIVE, sets it to RESERVED, and increments row_version.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      listingId - the listing to reserve
      sellerUsername - the expected seller of the listing
      Returns:
      true when exactly one LIVE listing was reserved, false when it is missing, not owned by the seller, or no longer LIVE
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the connection is null or auto-commit is enabled
      SQLException - when the update fails

    • create

      public void create(Listing listing) throws SQLException
      Save a new listing and its 0-6 images together. The service supplies the ID, seller, validated fields, and Pending Review status. Both tables are rolled back if saving fails.

      The connection and transaction are owned by this method; the listing row and its photo rows are committed together.

      Parameters:
      listing - the listing to insert; its ID, seller, type and status must already be set and its photos are stored in order
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the ID is missing, the type is null or the status is not ListingStatus.PENDING_REVIEW, the condition is unknown, there are more than six photos, a photo is empty or larger than 16 MiB, or the type-specific price/lending fields are invalid
      SQLException - when the insert fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • findAllListing

      public List<Listing> findAllListing() throws SQLException
      Returns every non-removed listing, oldest first, with its photos.

      Uses a new connection and joins the seller's current full name from users. Listings with status REMOVED are excluded; photos are loaded on the same connection.

      Returns:
      non-removed listings ordered by posting time and ID; never null
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findBySeller

      public List<Listing> findBySeller(String sellerUsername) throws SQLException
      Returns a seller's non-removed listings, with agreed deal terms when one exists.

      Uses a new connection. Listings with the terminal outcomes SOLD, GIVEN or LENT sort after the others, then newest first; REMOVED listings are excluded. Photos are loaded on the same connection.

      Parameters:
      sellerUsername - the seller whose listings are returned
      Returns:
      the seller's non-removed listings with photos; never null
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findByStatus

      public List<Listing> findByStatus(ListingStatus status) throws SQLException
      Returns every listing with the given status, oldest first. Used by the admin review screen with ListingStatus.PENDING_REVIEW, and reusable for other status filters (e.g. an "all live listings" view). Removed listings are never returned, even when asking for ListingStatus.REMOVED.

      Uses a new connection and loads photos on the same connection.

      Parameters:
      status - the exact listing status to match
      Returns:
      matching non-removed listings ordered by posting time; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when status is null
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findByIdAndSellerForUpdate

      public Listing findByIdAndSellerForUpdate(Connection conn, String id, String seller) throws SQLException
      Lock an owned row for a caller-owned seller change transaction.

      The row is read with FOR UPDATE and removed listings are excluded. This method never commits; the caller owns commit/rollback and closes the connection.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      id - the listing ID
      seller - the expected seller username
      Returns:
      the locked listing, or null when no non-removed listing with that ID belongs to the seller
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when conn is null or auto-commit is enabled
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • updateReview

      public boolean updateReview(String listingId, ListingStatus status, String rejectionReason, long expectedRowVersion) throws SQLException
      Records an admin review decision. Only listingStatus, reviewed_at and rejection_reason are written; every other column (content, seller, photos) is untouched. Approving with ListingStatus.LIVE clears any old rejection reason; rejecting requires a non-blank reason (the table CHECK enforces the same rule). The update only succeeds while the listing is still PENDING_REVIEW and its row_version still equals the version the admin reviewed, so a seller edit or a second admin decision between loading the queue and deciding is detected instead of approving content nobody reviewed. Uses a new connection.
      Parameters:
      listingId - the listing being reviewed
      status - the review decision; approval uses ListingStatus.LIVE and rejection uses ListingStatus.REJECTED
      rejectionReason - the required rejection text when rejecting; ignored and cleared for any other status
      expectedRowVersion - row_version the admin saw when the listing was loaded
      Returns:
      true when the listing was still pending with that version and was updated
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the listing ID is blank, the status is null, or a rejection has a blank reason
      SQLException - when the update fails

    • removeListing

      public boolean removeListing(String listingId, String username, String reason) throws SQLException
      Soft delete: marks one owned listing as REMOVED, keeping its row, photos and history. Removed listings are excluded from every find method in this repository.

      Uses a new connection and increments row_version so a concurrent review or edit sees a conflict.

      Parameters:
      listingId - the listing to remove
      username - the seller that must own the listing; it is trimmed before use
      reason - the rejection reason recorded on the listing
      Returns:
      true when the listing existed, was not already removed and was updated
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the listing ID, username or reason is blank
      SQLException - when the update fails

    • updateOwned

      public void updateOwned(String id, String seller, Listing listing) throws SQLException
      Updates an owned listing's content and photos in one new connection and transaction.

      The row is locked with FOR UPDATE; only listings in PENDING_REVIEW, LIVE or REJECTED may be edited. The listing is sent back to Pending Review with its review result cleared and row_version incremented, and the photo set is replaced entirely (including when all photos are removed).

      Parameters:
      id - the listing ID
      seller - the seller that must own the listing
      listing - the new content and photo set
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the row is missing, not owned by the seller, or its status no longer allows editing
      SQLException - when any statement fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • updateOwned

      public void updateOwned(Connection conn, String id, String seller, Listing listing) throws SQLException
      Content and photo replacement without committing the caller's transaction.

      The caller owns the connection and commit/rollback. The row is locked with FOR UPDATE; the listing is reset to ListingStatus.PENDING_REVIEW with its review result cleared and row_version incremented, and the photo set is replaced in the same transaction.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      id - the listing ID
      seller - the seller that must own the listing
      listing - the new content and photo set
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the connection is not transactional, or the row is missing, not owned by the seller, or its status no longer allows editing
      SQLException - when any statement fails

    • updateAsAdmin

      public boolean updateAsAdmin(String id, Listing listing) throws SQLException
      Admin content edit: updates every listing field and replaces the photo set. Unlike the seller path it accepts any current status, and the listing is sent back to Pending Review with its previous review result cleared.

      Opens and commits its own transaction on a new connection; row_version is incremented.

      Parameters:
      id - the listing ID
      listing - the new content and photo set
      Returns:
      false when no listing has that id
      Throws:
      SQLException - when any statement fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • updateAsAdmin

      public boolean updateAsAdmin(Connection conn, String id, Listing listing) throws SQLException
      The same admin content update using the caller's transaction, so related writes (notifications, deal changes) commit or roll back together. The caller owns commit/rollback. Returns false without writing when no listing has that id.

      The connection is used as supplied and is never committed, rolled back or closed here.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle and transaction boundary
      id - the listing ID
      listing - the new content and photo set
      Returns:
      true when a listing row was updated, false when no listing has that id
      Throws:
      SQLException - when any statement fails

      Soft-removes an owned listing in one new connection and transaction, keeping its row, photos and deal history.
      Parameters:

      Throws:

    • deleteOwned

      public void deleteOwned(Connection conn, String id, String seller) throws SQLException
      Remove from marketplace while retaining deal history and its referenced listing.

      Caller-owned connection: this method never commits. Locks the row with FOR UPDATE, checks that its status still allows removal, then sets REMOVED and increments row_version.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      id - the listing ID
      seller - the seller that must own the listing
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the connection is not transactional, or the listing is missing, not owned by the seller, or no longer in an editable status
      SQLException - when the row cannot be removed
